terra.problem: “On his way out the door” makes it sound as though Pharaoh is leaving. The passage says he tells the Israelites to depart.
The passage says the Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, but does not say they traveled on one road.
The text says they had not prepared provisions, not that nobody got a head start on packing anything.
The explanation repeats the verse without adding insight or Papa Dorin’s personality. It feels flat.
